title: The Game Awards 2026 Reveals Nominees
content:
The Game Awards announced its list of 2026 nominees on Tuesday. The nominees for Game of the Year include Nintendo 's The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake and CAPCOM 's Resident Evil Requiem game. Other nominees are IO Interactive's 007 First Light , Remedy's Control Resonant , S-GAME's Phantom Blade Zero , and Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto VI , which launches on Thursday.

Resident Evil Requiem also got nominations for Best Game Direction, Best Narrative, Best Audio Design, and Best Action/Adventure. Angela Sant'Albano earned a nomination for Best Performance for her voice and motion-capture role as the protagonist Grace Ashcroft.

Other nominees from Japanese game franchises, or developed or published by Japanese companies or their overseas subsidiaries, include:

• Best Game Direction: Pragmata

• Best Audio Design: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve

• Best Ongoing: Final Fantasy XIV

• Best Ongoing: Fortnite (which features anime and Japanese game collaborations)

• Best Debut Indie: Orbitals

• Best Mobile Game: Monster Hunter Outlanders

• Best Mobile Game: Pokémon Champions

• Best Action Game: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve

• Best Action Game: Onimusha: Way of the Sword

• Best Action/Adventure: Pragmata

• Best RPG: Final Fantasy Resonance

• Best RPG: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave

• Best RPG: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection

• Best RPG: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter

• Best Fighting Game: My Hero Academia: All's Justice

• Best Fighting Game: Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls

• Best Family Game: Pokémon Pokopia

• Best Family Game: Yoshi and the Mysterious Book

• Best Family Game: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort

• Best Sim/Strategy: Pokémon Pokopia

• Best Sports/Racing: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort

• Best Multiplayer: Orbitals

• Best Adaptation: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 anime

• Best Adaptation: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie

• Best Adaptation: Resident Evil live-action film

• Most Anticipated: Final Fantasy VII Revelation

• Most Anticipated: Resident Evil Veronica

• Innovation in Accessibility: Rhythm Heaven Groove

The Player's Voice nominees will be announced on November 30.

The awards ceremony will be held on December 10 at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles.

Fans can vote for their favorite games on The Game Awards' website until December 9 at 9:00 p.m. EDT.

Last year, Cygames ' Uma Musume Pretty Derby game won Best Mobile Game, Mario Kart World won Best Sports/Racing Game, Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves won Best Fighting Game, FINAL FANTASY TACTICS - The Ivalice Chronicles won Best Sim/Strategy Game, and Donkey Kong Bananza won Best Family Game.
author: ANN

title: New Boruto Preview Teases Disappointing Shift Away From a Major Fight
content:
The new chapter of Boruto: Two Blue Vortex , Chapter 39, is just around the corner, and as the series usually does, it has released previews for the upcoming chapter. It was highly expected that the chapter would pick up on the major fight it had set up, with Boruto and Sarada joining forces against Code and Hidari. Seeing these characters stand against each other was something fans wanted, as the series had established the perfect dynamic for them. However, it was expected that Boruto and Code’s fight would unfold under different circumstances, while Sarada would face Hidari separately.

This setup is honestly even more exciting and aligns with the lore the series is trying to present, highlighting Boruto and Sarada’s dynamic and their union against important foes. With the previous chapter setting all the pieces in place, it was implied that the upcoming chapter would continue this development. However, not one but two previews have already been released, and neither features a sneak peek at this highly anticipated fight. Instead, the previews hint at two different, slower developments, both of which are also important to the series’ lore.

Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 39 Previews Hint at a Shift in Focus to Two Different Lore Threads

The first preview for Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 39, released on November 13, focuses on a simple family conversation between Kawaki and Himawari. The main context of the preview reveals how, despite not being real siblings, the two share a genuine sibling bond. Kawaki takes on the role of an older, protective brother who is still awkward and unable to handle his younger sister’s affection, while Himawari acts like a happy little sister, delighted to see her big brother enjoying the food she made. Meanwhile, the second preview, released on November 17, features an intriguing conversation between Jura and the bookstore owner, who is engaging with Jura on Shikamaru’s instructions, knowing that doing so is a way of saving the world.

The conversation between the two, however, is not something comedic but rather an intriguing discussion about evolution. The bookstore owner explains evolution through the analogy of predator and prey, using deer and tigers to highlight how they have evolved and adapted their nature. While these two previews might seem completely random, they are nevertheless important to the series’ lore. With Kawaki considering letting Naruto out soon , seeing Himawari’s feelings toward her family and her real brother, Boruto, helps the series establish the emotional groundwork for how these relationships could affect Kawaki’s future actions, especially his decision to kill Boruto. Meanwhile, Jura’s interest in these discussions has consistently revolved around evolution.

As the leader of the Human God Tree entities, Jura has been learning about the world and has come to understand important elements such as love and how it can also lead to a person’s evolution. Through this phenomenon, Jura, who is himself evolving as a Human God Tree, could discover new aspects of his existence and evolve much faster. This is what makes these two previews for the new Boruto chapter just as important, even if they appear to replace the major fight everyone was expecting. However, there is still a strong possibility that the anticipated fight will feature in the new Boruto: Two Blue Vortex chapter, as the two previews cover relatively minor events that could be wrapped up quickly, leaving the rest of Chapter 39 to focus on the main fight.

title: Exclusive: Giant Ojosama Joins HIDIVE Winter 2027 Lineup, Anime Frontier Premiere Set for December 4
content:
HIDIVE has acquired Giant Ojosama for its Winter 2027 simulcast lineup, with the comedy anime set to stream exclusively on the service beginning in January 2027. The series will be available in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand.

HIDIVE will also host the anime’s North American premiere during Anime Frontier 2026 in Fort Worth, Texas on December 4, while the event will run through December 6. Anime Corner has the exclusive opportunity to share the English sub trailer first, and you can check it out below.

Based on the manga written and illustrated by Nikumura-Q, Giant Ojosama follows Oriko Fujido, the heiress to the Fujido Zaibatsu, a company that controls the world’s largest beverage and vending machine business. After receiving an entire town as a gift for her fourth birthday, Oriko spends the following decade helping it develop alongside her butler and researcher, Dr. Sebastian.

When a giant invader attacks, Sebastian gives Oriko an experimental energy drink that causes her to grow to skyscraper size. She sets out to defend the town, although her attempts to stop the threat create further destruction along the way.

The main voice cast was previously revealed and includes:

• Yu Serizawa as Oriko Fujido

• Junya Enoki as Dr. Sebastian

• Rina Kawaguchi as Stella

• Risa Imayanagi as Madoka Ito

Staff:

• Director: Hiroshi Ikehata

• Assistant Director: Katsuya Oshima

• Series Composition / Script: Yu Sato

• Character Design / Chief Animation Director: Hajime Mitsuda

• Animation Production: Tatsunoko Production

HIDIVE President John Ledford commented:

“We’re excited to add the new comedy series Giant Ojosama to our exclusive simulcast slate for the upcoming Winter 2027 season. Anticipation for this show has grown non-stop since it was first revealed in Match 2025. Now finally, the wait will soon be over for one of the top most wanted anime adaptations in recent years! With a skyscraper-sized 14 year old girl as the main character, there isn’t any doubt that Giant Ojosama will entertain audiences everywhere and illicit giant-sized laughs all season. What a fun show to kick off the New Year!”

Giant Ojo-sama began serialization on Shogakukan’s Sunday Webry manga platform on July 30, 2021. The series was originally published as a webcomic on Shueisha’s Jump Rookie website on December 17, 2020. The first collected volume was released on November 12, 2021, and as of September 2026, the series has been compiled into 13 volumes. The official website describes the story: Fujido Oriko, the daughter of a wealthy businessman, was given a “city” as a present on her fourth birthday. She nurtures and grows the city until one day, a giant enemy appears and threatens its peace. In the midst of the crisis, her butler, Sebastian, hands her a mysterious growth drink, leading to an unexpected transformation. A comedy series where the bigger things get, the more lovable they become.
author: Anime Corner

title: Ted: The Animated Series Trailer Expands Seth MacFarlane’s Universe on Peacock – Watch Now
content:
Ted is now in the works on continuing its story with a brand new animated series, and the first full look at it in motion has been revealed with a new trailer ahead of its release with Peacock. Following the somewhat success of the first two films, the Ted franchise found a whole new realm of popularity thanks to two strong seasons of a TV series released with Peacock . Now it’s all set to continue now with a third season, but with a new animated series instead.

Ted: The Animated Series takes place 12 years after the events of the two feature films , and continues Ted and John’s story as the two of them have since become neighbors and are raising their families together. With both Seth MacFarlane and Mark Wahlberg reprising their roles as the main duo from the film, it’s a whole new expansion of the MacFarlane universe coming to Peacock this December. You can check out the trailer below.

When Does Ted: The Animated Series Come Out?

Ted: The Animated Series will be making its debut with Peacock on Thursday, December 17th with eight episodes , and additional episodes are planned for a release sometime in 2027. No concrete release date has been revealed for these future episodes as of this time, but it’s going to feel very familiar to fans of both the live-action Ted series and MacFarlane’s various animated projects like Family Guy with some of the production team and studio from both projects being involved with this new series.

Ted: The Animated Series has been created Seth MacFarlane, Paul Corrigan and Brad Walsh (who also executive produced the live-action Ted series) with Corrigan and Walsh serving as showrunners with animation produced by Rough Draft Studios, Inc. The core cast from the second film are all set to reprise their respective roles with Seth MacFarlane as Ted, Mark Wahlberg as John, Amanda Seyfried as Sam, and Jessica Barth as Tami-Lynn confirmed to return.

What’s Next for Ted: The Animated Series ?

Ted: The Animated Series is set over a decade from the events of Ted 2, and picks up in a new phase of Ted and John’s likely wild life. New additions to the family seen in the trailer and promotional materials are Kyle Mooney as Apollo and Liz Richman as Ruth, but it remains to be seen how they fit into the overall dynamic. Unfortunately for those fans who wanted to see more of the live-action series continue with Peacock instead , MacFarlane revealed that it’s just too expensive of a series for Peacock to produce.

“What I kept hearing [from Peacock and Universal] was, ‘Listen, the show is really expensive to produce and there’s no way to do it at a lower cost,” MacFarlane said about the end of the Ted TV series . “So I said, ‘All right, I hear you loud and clear.’ So I wrote the last scene with Max [Burkholder] walking into a gym, presumably coming out as Mark Wahlberg in the first Ted film.” With the live-action series wrapping back into the events of the films, and this new animated series moving the story forward from there, it seems like Ted’s future is only going to be animated.

What do you think of Ted: The Animated Series so far? Would you want to see more of the live-action series instead? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Maki Terashima-Furuta Joins ASIFA-Hollywood's Board of Directors Ahead of 54th Annie Awards' New Anime Category
content:
The 54th annual Annie Awards will take place on February 20, 2027.

The Annie Awards recognize outstanding achievement in animation. ASIFA-Hollywood added the Best Animated Independent Feature award for the 2016 awards in order to "recognize not only features in wide release, but also the independent animators, international studios, anime and special productions that might not otherwise get the attention they deserve." Mamoru Hosoda 's Mirai film won the award in 2019.

In 2024, Hayao Miyazaki won the award for Best Storyboarding for a feature film, and animation director Takeshi Honda won the award for Best Character Animation for a feature film, both for The Boy and the Heron . Studio Ghibli composer Joe Hisaishi received the prestigious Winsor McCay Award in recognition of lifetime or career contributions.

California-based studio Tonko House 's Oni: Thunder God's Tale CGI animated series received awards in 2023 for Best TV/Media – Limited Series and Best Production Design - TV/Media.

No anime won awards in 2026 , 2025 , 2022 , 2021 , or 2020 . The 2020 awards presented late director Satoshi Kon with the prestigious Winsor McCay Award.

Terashima-Furuta is the president of Production I.G. USA . Terashima-Furuta previously served as the vice president of the U.S. subsidiary of Production I.G since she founded the company in 1997.

She has overseen development, production, and distribution for works such as Mamoru Oshii 's live-action Avalon film, Ghost in the Shell 2: Innocence , Cartoon Network 's IGPX , Cyborg 009 , DreamWorks ' live-action Ghost in the Shell film, Netflix 's Castlevania seriesm and Kill Bill Chapter 3: The Origin of O-Ren . Terashima-Furuta has also worked as a producer or executive producer on such anime projects as Uzumaki , Fena: Pirate Princess , Love Hina , Immortal Grand Prix , Blood: The Last Vampire , Halo Legends , FLCL , FLCL Alternative , FLCL Progressive , FLCL: Grunge , FLCL: Shoegaze , Mao-chan , Oblivion Island: Haruka and the Magic Mirror , and Eden of the East .

title: Black Clover Season 2 Gives Noelle the Reunion She’s Been Waiting 9 Years For
content:
Black Clover Season 2 has been giving its characters some big moments that fans have been waiting for since the anime began nearly a decade ago , and the newest episode gave Noelle’s family a much needed reunion after her big win. Black Clover Season 2 is now in the midst of the Spade Kingdom Raid Arc as the Magic Knights are facing off against the Dark Triad, and things got tougher for Noelle as the Supreme Devil Megicula had emerged from Vanica’s body at the edge of the Zogratis sibling’s defeat.

Black Clover Season 2 has ramped up the fight against Megicula as while Noelle was able to reach the supremely strong Saint Stage for a short time , it was still not enough to deal the final blow to the Supreme Devil before it was too late. Luckily, her brother Nozel arrived just in time to help her and Noelle was able to fully defeat Megicula with the help of the others. Resulting in the brief return of their mother Acier as she praises them for making it this far.

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 7 Reunites the Silva Family

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 7 sees Nozel arriving to help Noelle just in time, and through a flashback it’s explained why he’s been so distant from her all this time. Acier had previously fought against Vanica when Megicula first formed a contract with her, and it left the Silva mother with a curse that slowly killed her from the inside out. Nozel had seen it all go down, but he was also cursed in that moment to keep Acier’s real cause of death a secret or he would die as well.

Nozel took on the brunt of his pain alone, and thus had pushed Noelle away by treating her so harshly while he sought out power to take down Megicula in his own way. But with the Supreme Devil’s defeat with the latest episode, Acier’s spirit briefly appears before the two siblings and praises them for how hard they have worked for all this time. It’s an emotional full circle moment for this family that has been so broken apart after the matriarch’s death, and hopefully opens up a path forward.

What Does This Mean for Noelle’s Future?

Black Clover Season 2 has had some big developments for Noelle as not only has she gotten physically stronger, she’s also made some big emotional changes as well. This moment with her brother is likely to strengthen their connection with one another and hopefully begins the path to healing from their strained history, but Noelle has also become much more self-realized. This same fight also saw Noelle fully accept that she has romantic feelings for Asta , and she’s no longer hiding from that fact.

But fans of Yuki Tabata’s original Black Clover manga series know that this is unfortunately far from the end of everything. This is all leading to a much bigger arc to come with even more intense fights for Noelle and the others, so it just remains to be seen how the anime is going to tackle everything from here on out . How do you feel about all of Noelle’s big moments in Black Clover ‘s latest episode? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 7 sees Nozel arriving to help Noelle just in time, and through a flashback it’s explained why he’s been so distant from her all this time. Acier had previously fought against Vanica when Megicula first formed a contract with her, and it left the Silva mother with a curse that slowly killed her from the inside out. Nozel had seen it all go down, but he was also cursed in that moment to keep Acier’s real cause of death a secret or he would die as well.

Nozel took on the brunt of his pain alone, and thus had pushed Noelle away by treating her so harshly while he sought out power to take down Megicula in his own way. But with the Supreme Devil’s defeat with the latest episode, Acier’s spirit briefly appears before the two siblings and praises them for how hard they have worked for all this time. It’s an emotional full circle moment for this family that has been so broken apart after the matriarch’s death, and hopefully opens up a path forward.
What Does This Mean for Noelle’s Future?

Black Clover Season 2 has had some big developments for Noelle as not only has she gotten physically stronger, she’s also made some big emotional changes as well. This moment with her brother is likely to strengthen their connection with one another and hopefully begins the path to healing from their strained history, but Noelle has also become much more self-realized. This same fight also saw Noelle fully accept that she has romantic feelings for Asta , and she’s no longer hiding from that fact.

But fans of Yuki Tabata’s original Black Clover manga series know that this is unfortunately far from the end of everything. This is all leading to a much bigger arc to come with even more intense fights for Noelle and the others, so it just remains to be seen how the anime is going to tackle everything from here on out . How do you feel about all of Noelle’s big moments in Black Clover ‘s latest episode? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Dragon Ball Super Remake Post-Credits Scene Confirms New Take on One of the Most Divisive Arcs
content:
Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has officially ended its new take on the Battle of Gods arc with the latest episode , and has now confirmed that the Resurrection F arc is coming next with the first tease for the next episode. Dragon Ball Super ‘s new remake series has been offering an “enhanced” version of the now classic TV anime series, and the first few episodes have already improved the Battle of Gods arc to some degree. But the real test comes next with a new take on the Resurrection F arc.

Much like the Battle of Gods arc before it, the Resurrection F arc originally began as a Dragon Ball Z feature film release before eventually being re-adapted into a TV version of the arc for the Dragon Ball Super TV anime series. But unlike the Battle of Gods arc, this arc remains divisive among fans to this day not because of its animation but with many of the choices it made at its core. This new remake does offer a chance to correct some of those past mistakes.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Episode 7 First Look Confirms Resurrection F Arc

The post-credits scene for Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Episode 6 sees a few members of the Frieza Force noting how they are trying to strengthen up their forces once more for the Emperor’s return. It’s a tease that fans would immediately recognize from the Resurrection F arc, and that’s further confirmed to be the case as “Resurrection F” is the title of the next major episode. This raises a bunch of questions for the remake’s take on the arc as the first two attempts have really divided fans over whether or not it was ultimately a successful return for Frieza in general .

The Resurrection F arc sees Frieza coming back to life, and achieving the godly level Golden Frieza form for the occasion. It’s notable because it also features the debut of the Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan form, but was derided by fans for some of the decisions it made surrounding Gohan and Earth’s other Z Fighters at the time. But a retooled version of the arc could improve it with this new remake series. Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has been dividing fans with its own changes seen thus far , but this will be the real test of the remake idea.

How Long Will the Resurrection F Arc Be in Dragon Ball Super: Beerus ?

It’s yet to be revealed how many episodes the Resurrection F arc will last within Dragon Ball Super: Beerus . With the Battle of Gods arc being condensed into just six episodes compared to the original version’s 18, it’s likely that this arc will be even shorter than that. It was only nine episodes long in the original anime, so a condensed and more streamlined version of the arc will work its way through in a much quicker fashion. Especially because there’s still one more arc confirmed to be on the way .

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has also confirmed it will be showcasing a new version of the Universe 6 arc after this, but has yet to confirm its total number of episodes. The anime is quickly approaching the end of the Fall 2026 slate, but it’s likely that the series will be going beyond that into the Winter 2027 months beginning in January if each arc will have at least five to six episodes each. But what are you hoping to see from this next take on the Resurrection F arc? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Light Novel 'Saigo ni Hitotsu dake Onegai shitemo Yoroshii deshou ka' Concludes with 8th Volume
content:
The official X account for author Nana Ootori announced on Tuesday that the Saigo ni Hitotsu dake Onegai shitemo Yoroshii deshou ka ( May I Ask for One Final Thing? ) light novel series will end with its eighth volume, scheduled to be released on December 1.

Ootori began penning the action romcom novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in April 2018. AlphaPolis began publishing the novel under its Regina Books imprint with illustrations by Satsuki in August 2018 and published the seventh volume in December 2025.

Sora Hoonoki began drawing a manga adaptation on the Regina platform in June 2019. AlphaPolis published the 11th volume in December 2025.

AlphaPolis licensed the manga for digital release in English in July 2021 and released the tenth volume in November 2025.

A 13-episode television anime adaptation produced by LIDENFILMS aired in Fall 2025. Crunchyroll streamed the series with subtitles in multiple languages, as well as dubbed versions in English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, and Hindi.

Synopsis Ever since childhood, Scarlet El Vandimion has preferred to deal with wrongdoers by using her fists. However, to preserve her family's image, she suppresses her instincts and tolerates the abuse inflicted by her childish fiancé, Second Prince Kyle Von Pallistan. Only Kyle's brother, First Prince Julius, is aware that there is more to Scarlet than meets the eye, but she cares little about his growing interest.

In the middle of a ball, Kyle accuses Scarlet of harassing Terenezza Hopkins, a commoner that has taken his heart. Scarlet's engagement to Kyle is nullified, leaving her outraged that all of her efforts to endure thus far have amounted to nothing. Scarlet dons her studded leather gloves, once again becoming the "Mad Dog Princess." Joined by Julius and werebeast Nanaka, Scarlet is ready to give filthy nobles a taste of their own medicine—one punch at a time. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

Special novel site: https://www.alphapolis.co.jp/media/saihito

title: Avatar: The Last Airbender Co-Creator Addresses Next Major Series Release Date
content:
Avatar: Seven Havens is currently taking up all of the attention right now, but the co-creator behind the franchise has addressed when fans might be able to see the next major series coming in the Avatar Studios pipeline. And it’s going to take a lot longer than what fans might think. Avatar Studios kicked off a whole new era for the Avatar: The Last Airbender franchise as creators Bryan Konietzko and Michael DiMartino have begun to release new projects moving the timeline forward for a new generation of fans.

Konietzko and DiMartino announced during New York Comic Con 2026 earlier this Fall that Avatar Studios is already hard at work on the next major series, Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos . This new series will be going back in time with the Avatar Cycle to focus on the titular Kuruk’s time as the Avatar, and when asked about its potential release window by IGN , DiMartino revealed that it’s entirely up to Paramount but also reveals that it might be a while before we see the series as “That’s just getting started.”

Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos Gets Disappointing Release Window Update

“That is beyond my scope of control, DiMartino stated when asked about when Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos could potentially release. “So it’ll depend on what Paramount Plus wants to do, I guess, or whatever the streaming app happens to be at that time.” But it also turns out that it might be much further off than fans would hope for as DiMartino elaborates with, “That’s just getting started. It might be a bit before we have episodes ready for that.” But with so little revealed about this new series thus far , waiting a bit longer for its release makes a lot of sense.

Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos will feature Bryan Konietzko and Michael DiMartino as showrunners for the series produced in collaboration with Avatar Studios and Nickelodeon Animation Studios for a release with Paramount+ . No release window had been announced for the series when it was first announced, and DiMartino’s comments tease that its release is likely further away. But it’s likely going to release sometime after Avatar: Seven Havens ends its own run. And that’s going to be sooner than you think as well.

When Will Avatar Kuruk Series Come Out?

Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2 has been confirmed to make its debut with Paramount+ next May, and then Season 3 of the series will follow later in 2027. With two seasons coming next year, and a confirmation that it will end with its fourth season , this opens up a space for Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos to release shortly after. If we’re lucky, the new series could be making its debut sometime in late 2028 right after Avatar: Seven Havens wraps up its four season run. This would keep the hype train rolling along for sure.

When choosing to focus on Kuruk’s story for its own series, DiMartino told ComicBook that the initiative with Avatar Studios was to develop new projects that felt different from one another in style and genre, “When Brian [Konietzko] and I came to start Avatar Studios, since we were developing multiple things at once, we were very conscious of making sure each project felt different in genre and tone style and everything.” This teases an entirely different kind of series than seen before, so what are you hoping to see from the new Avatar Kuruk series? Let us know all of your thoughts in the comments.

HT – IGN
